props.name: series
props.description: One entry per group of points.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Name of the horizontal measure, printed under the axis.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Name of the vertical measure, printed beside the axis.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: trendLine
props.description: Draw a least-squares line through each series.

props.name: radius
props.description: Smallest and largest bubble radius, in viewBox pixels.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Format x values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: formatY
props.description: Format y values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: formatSize
props.description: Format bubble sizes in the tooltip.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the series key under the plot when there is more than one series.
